name: RokuroVR
summary:
Rest a hand on the clay and watch a vessel take shape. RokuroVR brings the quiet joy of pottery to Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S — no clay, no mess, no cleanup.

What you can do:

- Shape clay on the wheel with hands or controllers — it responds where you touch
- Fire your piece in the kiln, then build up the base and decorate
- Ceramic presets with a Japanese feel — white porcelain, celadon crackle, Oribe, Shino, Tenmoku — plus Surprise Me for a unique pattern every time
- Paint freely with brushes, fills, and
